sourceJustification: NTAD is the live distribution path for FRA NARN (same lineage, July 21 2026 vintage). FRA direct MapServer (fragis.fra.dot.gov) returned HTTP 500 'Service not started' on all recon probes — unusable for a writer. TxDOT TRIMSRR (maps.dot.state.tx.us) is Texas-only (breaks statewide-uniform OZ pattern), carries 13,155 RailMacro segments vs 16,522 NTAD TX segments, and lacks the NET status taxonomy (abandoned/removed/trail) in one field. NTAD adds companion NTAD_Railroad_Grade_Crossings for at-grade exposure. Licence: US government work (17 U.S.C. § 101), unrestricted public use per NTAD copyrightText.

statewideCompletenessProbe.note: Rail-trail (NET=T) is zero statewide in NTAD at recon time — CP2 weakness documented honestly.

bufferJustification: 500 feet (152.4 m) parcel-edge buffer. Typical railroad ROW is 50–100 ft; FRA quiet-zone and horn-audibility studies use quarter-mile (~402 m) around at-grade crossings — 500 ft captures adjacency/ROW encumbrance and crossing exposure without claiming full horn audibility radius. Matches on-vs-near discipline (buffer-intersect on parcel edge, not centroid-in-polygon). Value is stored on every atom body as bufferMeters.

CP1_sourceChoice.prompt: Is TxDOT TRIMSRR or live FRA MapServer actually better than NTAD?
CP1_sourceChoice.evidence: FRA direct service down (500). TxDOT is TX-only with fewer segments and no NET abandoned/trail taxonomy. NTAD is the NGDA distribution with working REST + grade-crossing sibling layer + nationwide uniformity.

CP2_abandonedAndRailTrailCoverage.prompt: Abandoned corridors and rail-trails are where this data is worst — probe exactly there.
CP2_abandonedAndRailTrailCoverage.evidence: Statewide NET=T count is 0 in NTAD TX (rail-trail not represented). Abandoned A+R totals 235 segments statewide; Dallas 48113 index shows 2 abandoned/trail segments vs 850 active index rows; Bastrop 48021 shows 0 abandoned/trail in county index. Grade-crossing point layer (159 Bastrop / 783 Dallas) partially covers at-grade exposure independent of corridor NET status. Writer does not claim completeness on abandoned/trail — emits nearest corridor status when nearRailCorridor=true.
